topics.name: Order Status and Tracking
topics.definition: Requests to find the location, delivery date, or current status of a specific order.

topics.name: Returns and Refunds
topics.definition: Requests to initiate returns, check refund status, or inquire about refund policies and timelines.

topics.name: Internal Reporting
topics.definition: Requests to generate stock reports, sales summaries, or track late deliveries for internal teams.

topics.name: Sales and Promotions
topics.definition: Requests about discount codes, promo codes, sales events, and voucher usage.

topics.name: Order Modifications
topics.definition: Requests to change delivery details, address, size, or add messages to an existing order.

topics.name: Payment and Billing
topics.definition: Requests regarding payment methods, declined transactions, split payments, or duplicate charges.

topics.name: Product Information and Support
topics.definition: Requests for product specifications, assembly instructions, care guides, or product availability.

topics.name: Account Management
topics.definition: Requests to modify account settings, reset passwords, manage security, or access personal data.

topics.name: Delivery Instructions
topics.definition: Requests to hold orders, change delivery slots, or arrange alternative delivery locations.

topics.name: Customer Service Access
topics.definition: Requests to speak to a human agent or inquire about service hours.
